Digital Engineering Craft

Kinetic Code

Mechatronics, code, and the stubbornness of someone who wants to understand how things really work.

This is the technical journal of a mechatronics engineer who spends the day between PLCs, C++, and cables that should not smoke — but sometimes do anyway. No ready-made tutorials, no LinkedIn fluff: here you find the real process. Bugs solved the hard way, machine cycles optimized bit by bit, design decisions made — and sometimes wrong — in front of an electrical cabinet at two in the morning.

If you are curious about the exact point where software meets metal, you are in the right place.
